title: Three Sundays and One Short Jar
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：ingredient　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ingredient 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the baker ① weighed the ingredient that no neighbour in the kitchen would have recorded, and he said the weighing was the whole of the Sunday. The ② ingredient, meaning the item itself and not the jar, ran three Sundays and stayed unrecorded in the book; a ingredient, he said, is the only thing in a kitchen that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ ingredient in that kitchen had the same short jar beside it, and the ④ ingredient at the far shelf, meaning the spice they kept for the children to smell and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A ingredient, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the baker said the recording is the part that fills three Sundays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the ingredient was the whole of the matter, meaning the flavour and not the item. The ⑥ ingredient, meaning the flavour and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; ingredient, he said, is either something you weigh or the only word that means both a item and a flavour. He said the flavour is the part they remember.

By 1993 the ⑦ ingredient had become a line in a card, and the card had become an argument about the short jar. The ⑧ ingredient of the whole thing, the baker wrote in June, was one kitchen and three Sundays of recording; ingredient, he said, is either the spice at the far shelf or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ ingredient I remember is the item recorded in the card, which closed in 1995 and is still recorded as the quietest in the kitchen. A ⑩ ingredient, my mother said in 1997, is the only item that improves by being recorded; every ingredient, she said, is a flavour that has agreed to look like a item. She said the flavour was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 原料；成分（指厨房里每一样旁边的那一样）
B. n. 原料；成分（指那样配料本身，与广口瓶相对）
C. 固定搭配：weigh the ingredient 称这种原料
D. n. 原料；成分（指留给孩子们闻的那一撮那一样）
E. n. 烹饪之事（抽象总称，指一处厨房的原料之事）
F. n. 原料；成分（指卡片里写到、被记下的的那一样）
G. n. 风味、滋味（指一件事里人人都配却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 滋味（抽象总称，指人人都配却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: weighed the ingredient that no neighbour in the kitchen would have recorded
The ingredient, meaning the item itself and not the jar
the ingredient at the far shelf

answers.why: weigh the ingredient 意为“称这种原料”，1988 年那位面包师把厨房里没有一位邻居肯记录的一样原料做了一遍。
ingredient 意为“原料；成分”，指那样配料本身而不是广口瓶，它经过了三个星期天而在簿子上没有被记录。
ingredient 意为“原料；成分”，指厨房里每一样旁边的那一样，每一样旁边都有同一只小小的广口瓶。
ingredient 意为“原料；成分”，指最远那列架边留给孩子们闻的那一撮那一样，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
ingredient 意为“风味、滋味”，指一件事里人人都配却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种风味就是那件事的全部。
ingredient 意为“滋味”，指人人都配却无人提起的那样东西而不是那样配料，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
ingredient 意为“原料；成分”，指卡片里写到、被记下的的那一样，到 1993 年这一样成了卡片里的一行。
ingredient 意为“烹饪之事”，面包师六月写道，整件事的原料之事是一处厨房和三个星期天的记录。
ingredient 意为“原料；成分”，我记得的是卡片里记录过的那一样，1995 年配齐了，至今仍被说成厨房里最安静的一样。
ingredient 为抽象总称，母亲 1997 年说，原料是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的配料。
